resources.title: BI Project Lifecycle: From Business Problem to Solution Infographic
resources.description: An end-to-end walkthrough of a real-world retail BI project (RetailCo) from stakeholder kickoff through requirements gathering, solution planning, data/analytics design, and final project plan sign-off. Covers the big-picture project flow (business problem to deploy & handoff), the key deliverables you'll actually build (data warehouse, ETL pipelines, operational reports, interactive dashboards, documentation), and example business questions the finished platform needs to answer.

resources.title: Building the Data Foundation: SQL Server + SSIS Infographic
resources.description: How raw retail data from POS, inventory, CRM, and file sources gets turned into a clean, reliable data warehouse: the SSIS extract-transform-load process, the SQL Server data warehouse it loads into, a star-schema design (FactSales with DimDate/DimProduct/DimStore/DimCustomer), a real SSIS package control-flow/data-flow example, before-and-after sample data showing what transformation actually fixes, and how SQL Server Agent automates and schedules the daily loads.

resources.title: Turning Data Into Business Intelligence: SSRS + Power BI Infographic
resources.description: How the same warehouse serves two different reporting needs: SSRS for formatted, parameter-driven, scheduled operational reports, and Power BI for interactive, self-service analytics dashboards. Includes a real Report Builder screenshot, a sample Power BI executive dashboard with KPI tiles and visuals, example DAX measures (Total Sales, Gross Margin %, Sales YTD, Sales YoY %), the business questions each tool is built to answer, and the business impact of getting this right.

resources.title: Taking the BI Platform Into Production: Testing to Handoff Infographic
resources.description: The final stretch of a real BI project: testing and validating the solution (data accuracy, report results, refresh logic, performance), deploying to production (SQL Server, SSIS Catalog, Report Server, Power BI workspace), automating and scheduling with SQL Server Agent, securing data with role-based access, and the actual handoff and adoption steps (stakeholder demo, documentation, user training, formal sign-off). Includes the final production architecture and the business results a finished platform delivers.

resources.title: What Is a Data Warehouse? Infographic
resources.description: A focused reference on the core concept underneath the whole program: the business problem siloed, inconsistent data creates; what a data warehouse actually does (integrates, cleans, organizes, and stores historical data as a single trusted source of truth); a real retail example; the end-to-end flow from source systems through SSIS into the warehouse and out to SSRS/Power BI; and the typical star-schema structure (fact table surrounded by dimension tables) that makes reporting fast and reliable.
